headline: ABC's livestreamed news show is powered by trending topics
summary: ABC News launched 'Searched,' a new livestreamed show. It focuses on trending social media topics and web searches. The show airs on ABC News Live, available on Disney Plus and other platforms.

headline: This compact Glorious mechanical keyboard is just $35
summary: The Glorious GMMK 3 mechanical keyboard is on sale for $34.99. This 65-percent keyboard is an ideal entry point for custom keyboard enthusiasts. Use coupon code WOOTGAMING at Woot for this limited-time deal.

headline: Wordle meets Clippy in this new word game
summary: A new word game, 'Dartwords,' blends Wordle-like puzzles with Clippy. It was created by Sam Rosenthal, known for 'Blaseball.' Players chase scores and share results, adding a nostalgic twist.

headline: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost
summary: YouTube will soon count a view as soon as a video starts playing. This new system aligns with Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. The change takes effect August 24th, expected to boost creator view counts.

headline: Tides of Annihilation Producer Responds After Gwendolyn's New Face Sparks Debate Among Fans
summary: Fans are debating graphical changes to the main character, Gwendolyn, in 'Tides of Annihilation.' New gameplay footage showed a distinctly altered face. The game's producer has issued a response to the controversy.

headline: Star Citizen Developer Stream Goes Horribly Off the Rails, Creating Further Distrust Among Players
summary: A recent 'Star Citizen' developer stream went horribly wrong. The disastrous stream led to increased fan distrust in the long-awaited game. Many players lost confidence following the event.

headline: Avengers: Doomsday Pre-Sale Tickets Are Outpacing Spider-Man: Brand New Day
summary: 'Avengers: Doomsday' pre-sale tickets are reportedly selling faster. Sales are outpacing 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' This indicates strong anticipation for the new Avengers title.

headline: GPU Swapping Spree Halted After Suspected Thieves Lose Power During Esports Hotel Heist
summary: Suspected thieves attempted a GPU swapping heist at an esports hotel. Their plans were foiled when the power was cut during the operation. The incident brought an end to their spree of graphics card thefts.

headline: Trump threatens to bomb US ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran deal
summary: Trump reportedly threatened to bomb Oman, a US ally. The threat is tied to Oman's independent talks with Iran over the Strait of Hormuz. It comes as a 60-day peace negotiation window expires.

headline: Tributes to actress Hayden Panettiere as coroner finds 'no signs of trauma'
summary: Tributes pour in for actress Hayden Panettiere, who died at 36. The coroner's report states no signs of trauma were found. She was known for roles in TV shows like 'Heroes' and 'Nashville.'

headline: Fifa executive leaves job three weeks after speaking out against Infantino plan
summary: Senior FIFA figure Kevin Lamour was sacked from his role. His dismissal followed public criticism of FIFA President Gianni Infantino's plans. The departure occurred just three weeks after his comments.

headline: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
summary: Andy Burnham reportedly communicated with someone impersonating Trump's chief of staff. The security breach was first reported by Politico. Downing Street has declined to comment on the incident.
